rule: Each two-colour chain (two edge-touching 4-connected pieces of different colours) is erased and re-placed rigidly by one of the 8 dihedral transforms plus a translation. One piece must exactly cover the background cells inside the bounding box of a same-colour socket group (parts linked at Chebyshev distance <= 2). The other piece must land in bounds on background or vacated chain cells. A reflection swaps the chain's two colours; a proper rotation keeps them.
scope: Rigid D4 seating of two-colour chains into socket holes, with colour swap only for reflected placements and forceable blocked alternative fits. One to three pairs on size-conditioned 10..30 rectangular canvases; all original examples rebuilt from latent sprites.
constraints: All five canonical pairs reconstruct exactly; 1000 independent archived-solver seeds pass.

authored_scope: Random mode: H,W in 10..30 (default 12..30), random bg, 1..3 chain/socket pairs (feasibility: 2 pairs need area >= 200; 3 pairs need area >= 360 and sides >= 12), all 8 seating transforms, either piece filling, forced or incidental hard negatives (symmetric filling piece whose alternative fit is blocked by the border or a socket). Placement is planned in two phases. Phase 1 seats the sockets: the forced hard pair goes first, all offsets are enumerated and geometrically filtered, then the uniqueness check is run incrementally; it is complete because fit legality depends only on bounds and socket cells. Phase 2 places the loose chains by full offset enumeration. Cramped grids (a side <= 12 or area < 150 per pair) use socket padding 0..1 instead of 0..2. Snapping falls back to unsnapped offsets when the snapped side has no valid offset. Explicit mode rebuilds all canonical fixtures from latent sprites. Not supported: non-rectangular socket outlines, more than 3 pairs, chains with more than two pieces, decoy holes that no chain fills.
authored_constraints: Background is the strict majority; non-background cells < 45% (tracked incrementally during planning).
Latent objects (socket rectangles, chains) are at Chebyshev distance >= 3 in the input; seated footprints do not touch; protrusions never overlap any socket rectangle.
Socket = padded rectangle minus filling footprint, bbox preserved, parts Chebyshev-2 linked; hole equals filling piece footprint.
Every legal fit of every chain into any hole yields exactly that chain's intended outcome (checked incrementally per pair and re-checked on the full grid).
Forced hard pairs have at least one blocked shape fit onto their own hole.
Chain and socket colours differ from bg; the two chain colours differ from each other and from the socket colour.
